dataset.title: LTEE published SNP presence across 264 sequenced clones

annotationIdentifierNormalization.scheme: REL606.feature.<six-digit 1-based feature ordinal in the immutable author GFF before sorting>
annotationIdentifierNormalization.originalIdQualifier: original_id retains the exact author ID on rows that supplied one; it is absent on originally unidentified rows.
annotationIdentifierNormalization.parentRelationships: The author supplied zero Parent attributes. Normalization adds zero Parent attributes or inferred gene/CDS relationships.
annotationIdentifierNormalization.preservation: All source columns1–8 and every other qualifier are preserved exactly in the source fixture. Replacing generated IDs with original_id, removing original_id, and removing IDs from originally unidentified rows reconstructs the author annotation-row multiset.
annotationIdentifierNormalization.snpPlacement: SNP placement depends on the unchanged exact reference sequence and reported point coordinates, not feature IDs.

unit: sequenced clones carrying this reported SNP

coordinateEvidence.authorScript: ComputeMutationThroughTimeDryad.pl lines166-172 prepends one placeholder to the embedded reference, then reported positions index that sequence; lines426-448 parse REF->ALT and complement ALT only when evaluating a reverse-strand gene codon.
coordinateEvidence.directReferenceCheck: All 14,572 unique SNP reference alleles match exact embedded REL606 at reportedPosition-1. Neighbor offsets -2,-1,+1,+2 match only 3,273,3,946,3,811,3,294 respectively.
coordinateEvidence.pointConversion: start0 = reportedPosition1 - 1; end0 = reportedPosition1; referenceAllele and alternateAllele remain on the forward reference strand.

matrixSemantics.rows: Unique source-defined SNP IDs. Distinct alleles at the same genomic position remain distinct rows.
matrixSemantics.one: The author lists that clone as carrying this SNP.
matrixSemantics.zero: This SNP is not listed for this clone within the deposited filtered mutation call set. This is not proof of coverage or a reference call at every genomic base.
matrixSemantics.scope: These definitions describe the unbundled clone-presence and matrix derivatives. The bundled data.csv carries presentCloneCount per unique author SNP ID.

limits: SNP-only native packet. 8,619 complex-event clone rows covering 2,670 author IDs are preserved separately; the compact table does not provide complete inserted/replacement alleles or qualified interval semantics.
The deposited mutation table excludes masked regions and regions near insertion-sequence elements. Its absence entries describe that filtered call set.
Carrier count spans sequenced clones and sampling times. It is not population allele frequency, mutation rate or a count of independent mutational origins.
The existing 132 means summarize the same 264 clone substitution counts. They are preserved separately and are not assigned genomic coordinates.
No generic RefSeq reference substitution, liftover, new mutation calling, coordinate guessing or cross-clone averaging is applied.

unbundledDerivedArtifacts.name: presence-matrix.csv
unbundledDerivedArtifacts.availability: Derived from the deposited mutation table during source validation. This representation is not bundled; the deposited original remains available at derivedFrom.

unbundledDerivedArtifacts.availability: Derived from the deposited mutation table during source validation. This representation is not bundled; the deposited original remains available at derivedFrom.

representation: Bundled data.csv contains one point per unique author SNP ID and the number of sequenced clones carrying that SNP. Per-clone and264-column matrix CSV derivatives are not bundled.
